docs(design): measured memory settles Gather as Node and sets the two ceilings (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.5d1) (#608)

* docs(design): measured memory settles Gather as Node and sets the two ceilings (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.5d1)

Measured on macOS, charge = phys_footprint through the backstop's probe.

- A bare idle node is 12 MB; the bundle with no sessions 55-65 MB; the load
  gate's daemon charges 68 / 103 / 389-397 MB at 1 / 10 / 100 sessions
  (3.3 MB per session). Gather's idle floor passes the 102 MB line (10% of the
  limit) with 37+ MB to spare.
- A session's source values live in the variable store the render cache's view
  holds, so the split moves a minority of a session's cost: about 0.46 MB of
  2.4 MB of collected heap per session is what the config gates (258 vs 212 MB
  at 100 sessions, two runs each). The state both processes would hold is
  about 5% of the daemon's charge at 100 sessions against a 10% line.
- Gather 448 MB and renderer 896 MB: the charge at 100 sessions times the
  2.6 headroom the single daemon's default carries, rounded up to 64 MB. The
  renderer's is set by its render cache (587 MB accounted at 100 sessions
  needs a limit of 868 MB), not by what moved out.

The ceilings are recorded in spec section 15 and added to limits.ts by the
tickets that read them. scripts/capture-heap.ts drives the daemon at N
sessions under a chosen config and writes a heap snapshot by signal;
startWorld takes extra daemon environment for it.

* fix(capture-heap): a run's snapshot is its own, whole, and on macOS; the doc names which rule binds each ceiling (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.5d1)

* fix(capture-heap): the snapshot is the daemon's by pid, and zero turns is a valid baseline (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.5d1)
